bundles.name: Kaitiaki
bundles.subtitle: Animal care, welfare and conservation, drafted for a licensed vet or authorised welfare officer to sign.

agents.name: DOC Species Recovery
agents.oneLiner: General support across the ~200 published Threatened Species Recovery Plans — tuatara, whio, takahē, kōkako, kākā, kea, tuna and more. Recovery-plan interpretation, translocation logistics, predator-control review. Taonga species route to a named kaitiaki reviewer.

agents.name: Doggy Daycare
agents.oneLiner: The operating system for a boutique NZ doggy daycare — enrolment to Welcome Pack, SMS pickup coordination in the carer’s voice, email in the owner’s voice, Xero invoicing, vaccination + council tracking. Every message and invoice is a draft the operator sends.

agents.name: Equine Vet
agents.oneLiner: Horse work across thoroughbred, harness, sport and leisure — lameness, colic triage, reproduction, pre-purchase exams, with live racing and FEI withdrawal-time checks before any prescription.

agents.name: Exotic, Avian & Reptile Vet
agents.oneLiner: A credible second opinion on birds, reptiles, small mammals and companion fish — husbandry-first, with a zoonotic check and a hard route to DOC when an "exotic" turns out to be a native.

agents.name: Keeper
agents.oneLiner: The front door to Kaitiaki. Routes an animal question to the right kind of care — companion vet, farm, equine, exotic, doggy daycare, welfare triage, wildlife rehab or Threatened Species Recovery. Every reply is a draft for a registered vet, welfare officer, licensed operator or named kaitiaki reviewer to sign.

agents.name: Large Animal Vet
agents.oneLiner: Production-animal herd health for dairy, beef, sheep, goats and deer — with withholding periods, NAIT checks and MPI notifiable-disease pathways that can never be suppressed.

agents.name: Rescue Coordination
agents.oneLiner: Multi-agency coordination for injured, orphaned or displaced animals — beached marine mammals, injured natives, displaced companions and weather-event response. Human safety first; trained responders act.

agents.name: Small Animal Vet
agents.oneLiner: Companion-animal consults for dogs, cats, rabbits and small mammals — a SOAP draft, differentials and a treatment plan for a registered veterinarian to examine and sign.

agents.name: SPCA Workflow
agents.oneLiner: Welfare case triage under the Animal Welfare Act 1999 — severity grading, jurisdiction, inspector-brief and MPI-referral drafting, and the adoption + foster pipeline, for an authorised welfare officer to sign.

agents.name: Wildbase Recovery
agents.oneLiner: The wildlife-hospital pathway — admission protocols, orthopaedic repair, oiled-seabird and lead-toxicity care, rehab and soft-release. Every admission drafts a DOC notification. A draft for a registered vet + kaitiaki reviewer.

agents.name: Zoo Vet
agents.oneLiner: Ex-situ collection support for NZ zoos — NZCCM-style clinical notes, species-management dashboards, ZAA + welfare-code compliance, and visitor-education content. Built with Auckland Zoo as design partner (concept · pilot pending).

agents.name: Kākāpō Recovery
agents.oneLiner: Field-ops support for the DOC Kākāpō Recovery Programme. Coming soon — held until a Ngāi Tahu + DOC tripartite sign-off. The model never generates whakapapa and never surfaces a tracked-bird location.

agents.name: Kiwi Conservation
agents.oneLiner: National Kiwi Recovery Plan support — Operation Nest Egg, community trap programmes, dog-avoidance in kiwi zones. Coming soon — ships only after a Kiwis for Kiwi MOU and rohe-appropriate kaumātua sign-off.
